## User stories
1. Kevin Smith first joins Fluent to work on translation projects for his local community church. He is the owner of the org, the project manager and a translator.
2. Kevin is invited by a larger Org in Fluent to help manage some of their projects. He is not doing any translating, only managing.
3. Kevin is invited by a Org C to help as a translator on a project. He is only a translator.
4. Kevin acts as an observer for other projects and orgs. He does not require editing or managing permissions.

## Implementation

#### Roles
- Org owner
- Org manager
- project manager
- project translator
- project observer (new 2026-03-03)

#### Associations
- The User is the central entity for the System 
- A user can be associated with multiple Orgs 1:m 
- Projects are associate to an Org 1:1 
- A user can have multiple roles per project 1:m 
- Roles are associated per org per project. 

Roles, Permissions, Orgs, Users 

**Roles and permissions by role** 
SuperAdmin - for System team members
org owner - owns the org, can administrate org and assign Org managers 
org manager - can admin org, cannot assign org managers (assumed) 
project manager - can manage project, assign users with PM or PT roles 
project translator - can update project content that they are assigned to in draft or peer-review, can update if content status is community review+
